how_to_read_page.title: How to read the data?
how_to_read_page.subtitle: Guidelines to understand the results and their limitations.

what_tool_observes.title: What the tool observes
what_tool_observes.text: Responses to the PME MTL / La Sphère HEC Montréal questionnaire. Each result specifies its population, its home territory, its question and its sample size.

territory_meaning.title: What territory means
territory_meaning.text: A business, a representative, a resident or a worker may be linked to a territory through different questions. The linkage rule must be documented for each indicator.

read_percentages.title: Reading the percentages
read_percentages.text: The denominator is the number of valid responses to the question among eligible respondents. Non-responses and “don’t know” answers are reported separately. No zero ever replaces missing data.

compare_territories.title: Comparing territories
compare_territories.text: Gaps refer to the same question, the same profile and the same period. The territorial benchmark is all respondents from the other four territories, using a weighting method yet to be validated.

results_limits.title: Limitations of the results
results_limits.text: Attractiveness essentially describes the East as a whole; performance is self-assessed; cooperation and competition form a perception axis. This is not an objective ranking of territories.

insufficient_data.title: When data is insufficient
insufficient_data.text: A publication threshold must be validated with the research team. If the sample size or comparability does not allow a reliable reading, the result is hidden and users can broaden the filters.

mockup_status.title: Status of this mock-up
mockup_status.text: Figures are not yet available. Bars, “—” values and “coming soon” text show where results will appear, with no demo data.
